purpose: Photorealistic concept visuals for the Speccy micro PDF prospectus

hero.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Asset type: transparent product cutout for a premium PDF prospectus. Input image 1 is the edit target: a CAD-derived three-quarter studio view of the Speccy micro handheld. Primary request: transform ONLY its material appearance and lighting into convincing photorealistic macro product photography. Keep this exact device, exact camera angle, perspective, silhouette, footprint, thickness, positions and sizes of every part, exact original framing and margins. Do not redesign it. Preserve the two-piece charcoal case, six circular controls (four ivory directional buttons, one muted coral A / Fire button, one pale teal M / Menu button), two slotted metal screws, recessed rectangular screen, existing Micro-B socket opening, SPECCY marking, four red/yellow/green/blue diagonal marks, and the exact illustrative pixel image and 48K text. Materials: near-black charcoal ABS/polycarbonate with extremely fine realistic molded grain and subtle satin highlights, ivory/coral/teal plastic caps with soft worn-in microtexture, genuine brushed stainless screw faces, detailed dark metal USB port, real LCD cover glass with faint broad softbox reflections that do not obscure the pixels. Lighting: professional neutral studio key softbox above-left, restrained cool rim light at right, physically plausible occlusion around every button, under the screen lip and case seam. Deep focus as in a focus-stacked 90mm macro product photograph at f/11; all labels and edges crisp. The product must feel physically small and manufactured, not a glossy toy or a smooth clay render. Clean and premium, only minute surface irregularities. Background: true transparent alpha, no backdrop, table, surface, cast floor shadow, vignette, checkerboard or halo. Keep the original 8:9 portrait canvas ratio and the device in exactly the same image-relative location and size. No added objects, controls, vents, wires, cable, ornaments, text or watermarks. This is a photorealistic concept visualization, not evidence of a manufactured prototype.

front.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Asset type: transparent straight-on product cutout for the same PDF prospectus. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the front CAD view. Input image 2 is only a MATERIAL AND LIGHTING REFERENCE, the approved photorealistic three-quarter view of the identical product. Transform image 1 into a convincing photorealistic focus-stacked macro studio photograph, matching the charcoal fine-grained satin ABS case, ivory plastic directional caps, coral Fire cap, teal Menu cap, brushed stainless screws and realistic LCD cover glass of image 2. Lock the FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC view of image 1: no tilt, no perspective change; preserve its exact silhouette, rounded corners, screen size and position, button and screw positions and sizes, original 7:9 portrait framing and margins. Keep all six round buttons: four ivory directions in the same diamond, coral button marked A at upper right, teal button marked M below it; two slotted screws at the bottom corners. Preserve the SPECCY name below the screen, the red/yellow/green/blue stripes at the top right, and the exact pixel screen illustration with 48K at the top and rainbow bar at bottom. Do not invent a game screenshot. Crisp small print, realistic fine molded texture, subtle edge highlights, crevice shadows and very faint glass reflections that preserve screen legibility. Studio softbox above-left, restrained neutral cool edge light; deep focus, f/11, high-end small electronics catalog photography, believable miniature scale, clean premium condition. Output true transparent alpha with no backdrop, tabletop, floor shadow, checkerboard, glow or halo. Do not alter geometry, crop, composition, control count, labels, color placement or internal artwork. No additional objects, ports, controls, cables, text, watermark or decorations. This is a concept visualization, not a photo of tested hardware.

exploded.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Asset type: transparent photorealistic exploded product visualization for a PDF technical spread. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the exact six-layer CAD exploded stack. Input image 2 is a MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY: the approved exterior finish of the same device. Convert image 1 into a high-end photorealistic exploded product photograph/visualization with physically believable materials, microtexture, reflections and occlusion. Preserve every original component, all silhouettes, board outlines and cutouts, the exact camera angle, layout, layer order, spacing, original 7:10 portrait framing and margins. The six layers must remain, from top to bottom: charcoal front shell with rectangular screen aperture, six existing round button plungers (four ivory, coral Fire, teal Menu), blue LCD board with glass display and its original tiny pixel artwork, the green custom carrier with precisely the existing six small switches and sparse parts, the green ESP32 substrate/module underneath, and the charcoal rear shell with its USB opening. Preserve the original two slotted screw faces and the existing short LCD interconnects. Match image 2's extremely fine molded satin charcoal ABS grain and restrained ivory/coral/teal cap colors. Use believable PCB soldermask sheen and fiberglass cut edges, reflective plated/gold contact pads, real stainless switch tops and screw faces, ceramic passive surfaces and dark IC plastic, subtle readable LCD glass reflection. VERY IMPORTANT: the custom carrier is an UNROUTED study. Keep all its blank green areas blank. Do not add copper traces, routing, components, solder patterns, labels, silkscreen, chips, logos or antenna details that are absent from image 1. Do not copy the branding/decoration of image 2 onto the blank exploded front shell. No new parts, no missing or merged layers, no reshaping, no extra controls. Soft neutral studio light from above-left with crisp but soft material highlights and subtle rim light; deep focus/focus stacking so all six layers are sharp. Clean premium macro product photography, realistic miniature electronics, not cartoon CGI or clay. True transparent alpha including every hole and gap, no background, table, floor shadow, support rods, checkerboard, backdrop or halo. No additional text or watermark. This remains a concept visualization, not manufacturing evidence.

back.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Asset type: transparent underside product cutout for the same PDF prospectus. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the underside CAD view. Input image 2 is only the MATERIAL/FINISH REFERENCE, the approved photorealistic three-quarter exterior. Make input 1 look like a professional focus-stacked macro photograph of the same tiny physical object. Change only materials, microtexture, reflections, light and shading. Match input 2's dark charcoal satin fine-grained ABS/polycarbonate finish and realistic metal Micro-B power socket. Keep input 1's exact underside camera view, orientation, silhouette, proportions, rounded corners, two-piece seam, thickness, socket opening, rectangular programming access window, original square canvas framing and margins. The back remains completely blank except for the existing narrow access window. Inside that window, make the existing six small gold programming contacts on green PCB visible and realistically reflective: exactly six, no extra contact rows, no added ports. Preserve the exact access-window size and location; do not widen it. No front controls are visible in this underside view. Keep the power connector as Micro-B, not USB-C, with realistically detailed recessed dark metal socket and contact tongue. Neutral studio key softbox from the upper-left, subtle cool rim on the charcoal edges, fine natural material highlights and crevice shadows, all edges and the access pads sharp. Genuine miniature electronic product photography, not a glossy plastic toy or a smooth clay render. True transparent alpha. No backdrop, table, floor shadow, vignette, black rectangle, checkerboard or colored fringe around the product; clean alpha edges for placement over a dark PDF. No new text, labels, barcode, screws, buttons, cables, vents, branding, props or watermark. Do not alter design or layout. This is a photoreal concept visualization, not evidence of a built or tested device.
back.correction_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the EDIT TARGET: the approved photorealistic underside Speccy micro concept image. Make one targeted correction ONLY. The narrow rectangular programming window currently shows five gold contact pads. Replace that row with EXACTLY SIX clearly separate, evenly spaced gold contact pads on the same green board, inside the same unchanged window. Six means 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6; all six must be visible and countable. Fit the six pads within the existing opening without enlarging or moving it. Use the same realistic gold material and pad shape. Keep every other pixel-level design feature unchanged: camera, composition, framing, square aspect, charcoal plastic grain, all case geometry, seam, Micro-B socket, shadows, highlights, colors and blank back. Preserve genuine transparent alpha and clean edges. Do not add text, symbols, objects or additional details. Change only the number/spacing of the gold programming contacts from five to six.
